kind_bubbles: Cat holds a small bubble wand in the right hand near the mouth, gently blows three times, then follows the floating bubbles with the head, delighted
glitter_throw: Cat scoops sparkles from a pocket with both hands, throws them up into the air with a graceful spin, then poses with hands under the chin
gum_blow: Cat stands relaxed with hands in pockets, chews, blows a big bubble gum bubble that pops, flinches slightly and shrugs coolly
idle_kind_cocoa: Cat holds a warm mug with both hands at chest height, blows on it, takes a sip and sighs happily
idle_glitter_mirror: Cat holds a small hand mirror in the left hand, looks into it, fixes the hair with the right hand, turns the head admiring itself
snowglobe_shake: Cat holds a snow globe with both hands, shakes it up and down a few times, then raises it and looks at it in wonder
sticker_slap: Cat slaps the right palm flat onto an invisible glass window in front at chest height like sticking a sticker, then points at it proudly
idle_hooligan_skate: Cat rides an invisible skateboard: a small kick push with one foot, then leans and rolls side to side with arms out for balance
idle_hooligan_headphones: Cat lifts the headphones from the neck onto the ears with both hands, then nods the head to the beat and taps one foot
peek_from_edge: Cat crouches low and leans to the side as if hiding, then slowly peeks out and waves shyly
stand_up: Cat gets up from sitting on the ground to standing and stretches the back
shy: Shy cat looks down, twists one foot on the floor, holds hands behind the back and sways shyly
proud: Proud cat puts fists on the hips, chest out, chin up, heroic pose, nods once
lean_in: Curious cat leans forward toward the viewer with hands on the knees and tilts the head
scratch_glass: Playful cat scratches an invisible glass window in front with both paws like a kitten
slide_down_glass: Cat presses face and palms against an invisible glass window in front, then slowly slides down into a crouch, comically
breath_draw: Cat breathes on an invisible window in front, then draws a heart in the air with one finger
poke_head: Poked on top of the head, the cat ducks, holds the head with both hands, then looks up annoyed but amused
poke_cheek: Poked on the cheek, the cat tilts the head away, rubs the cheek and giggles
point_button: Insistent cat points down and to the right with the right hand as if showing a button, looking at the viewer
dizzy: Dizzy cat wobbles on unsteady legs with the head spinning, nearly falls, then shakes the head to recover
wake_startle: Sleepy cat jolts awake startled, jumps slightly and looks around quickly
talk_excited: Excited cat talks with big hand gestures, bouncing on its toes
echo_speak: Cat cups both hands around the mouth and calls out loudly, leaning forward
hug_screen: Friendly cat steps forward and gives the viewer a warm hug, arms wrapping around, then steps back smiling
idle_tail_play: Cat turns around chasing its own tail, spins half a turn, stops dizzy and giggles
cover_ears: Cat covers both ears with the hands, squeezes the eyes and shakes the head
celebrate: Happy cat jumps up with both fists in the air celebrating a victory, then lands and cheers
purr_stroke: Content cat leans the head into a petting hand from above, eyes closed, sways happily side to side, shoulders relaxed
poke_paw: Poked on the paw, the cat pulls the hand back quickly, shakes it, then looks at it and laughs
poke_tail: Startled cat jumps up when its tail is touched, spins around to look behind and then turns back grinning
idle_stretch: Relaxed cat does a big full body stretch, arms up and back, rising on tiptoes, then relaxes with a satisfied shake
jump: Cheerful cat bends the knees and does a big happy vertical jump, landing softly with arms out
